user.title: Dishwasher Duty
user.description: Track who unloads the dishwasher. First pick the sensor that reports your dishwasher's programme state, e.g. the Home Connect "Operation state" sensor.

data_description.source_sensor: A sensor whose state changes to a "running" value during a programme and to a "finished" value at the end.

settings.title: States, persons and co-claiming
settings.description: Source sensor: `{sensor}`. Pick the states it reports while running and when finished - the list comes from the sensor, custom values are allowed. Upper/lower case does not matter.

data_description.running_value: State while a programme runs. Home Connect: `run`.
data_description.finished_value: State when a programme has ended. Home Connect: `finished`. Only a change from the running to this value opens a claimable cycle.
data_description.persons: People who get a claim button and a credit sensor.
data_description.allow_co_claim: If on, others can join within the co-claim window after the first claim and the credit of 1.0 is shared.
data_description.co_claim_window: Seconds after the first claim during which others can join (5-600).
data_description.debounce_seconds: Ignore another finished cycle within this many seconds of the previous one (0 = off). Helps with flapping sensors.

error.no_finished_value: Enter the state value that means "finished".
error.no_running_value: Enter the state value that means "running".
error.same_values: The "finished" and "running" values must be different.

abort.already_configured: This sensor is already tracked by Dishwasher Duty.

source_sensor_missing.description: The entry "{title}" watches `{entity_id}`, but that entity no longer exists, so finished cycles cannot be detected.
